c1.descriptionRaw:
The maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> additionally creates 1 <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>.
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.
c1.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing

c2.descriptionRaw:
While the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is present, all opponents within the <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> have their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.
c2.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness

c3.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill {LINK#S11362}<color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c3.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology

c4.descriptionRaw: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Cores{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
c4.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay

c5.descriptionRaw:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: {LINK#S11361}<color=#FFD780FF>Chain Reaction</color>{/LINK} by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
c5.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All

c6.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> is enhanced. If the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>:
 · Is in the Steady State: <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color> deals 115% of its original DMG.
· Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> whenever Mitya consumes a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> with the <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color>.
Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11190007}Elevated{/LINK}</color> by 20%.
c6.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason

profile.description: An exceptionally ingenious energy specialist and a master of the fine art of "schedule-dodging."
profile.name: Mitya
profile.title: Rules Set at Naught

labels: Gradient Detonation Stellar-Conduct DMG|{param10:F1P} Elemental Mastery

combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front after a short casting time.
Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Detonation</color>, which consumes no Stamina, if a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Overload{/LINK}</color> created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color>: Deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front and continuously consumes <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacons</color> while held. Each <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color> consumed deals 1 instance of <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> upon impact.
combat1.name: Chain Reaction

labels: Steady State Core Gradient Beacon Consumption DMG|{param4:F1P} Elemental Mastery
Steady State Core Detonation DMG|{param5:F1P} Elemental Mastery/Beacon

combat2.descriptionRaw:
Conducts a theoretically relatively safe experiment at a theoretically relatively safe yield, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creating a <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core{/LINK}</color> in different ways depending on whether the Skill is tapped or held.

Tapping the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Principle: Variable Detection</color> again within 6s after using it changes the <color=#FFD780FF>Detection Core</color>'s state. The Detection Core's state can be changed in this way every 1.5s.
combat2.name: Principle: Variable Detection

combat3.descriptionRaw: Let the elements burst forth like inspiration itself! Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> and creates 3 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color>.
combat3.name: Analysis: Gradient Theory

passive1.name: Baseline Stress Test

passive2.descriptionRaw: The duration of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacons{/LINK}</color> is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a <color=#FFD780FF>Gradient Beacon</color>. This effect can stack up to 4 times.
passive2.name: Explosive Reagent: Safe Limits Exceeded

passive3.descriptionRaw:
When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct. Stellar-Conduct reactions will no longer create <color=#FFD780FF>Starlight Prisms</color>, and will instead create 1 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360001}Gradient Beacon{/LINK}</color> nearby every 1.5s for 3s. These Beacons can be carried by Mitya and transform the area around them into an even larger <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>. Triggering another Stellar-Conduct reaction will refresh the duration of the aforementioned effects.
Additionally, the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all nearby party members will be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum Base DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%. While within a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, Mitya will also enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.
passive3.name: Stellar Jubilee: Top-Secret Protocol

passive4.descriptionRaw:
When destructible rocks are nearby, <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11360002}Detection Core: Steady State{/LINK}</color> can quickly clear them.
Additionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating <color=#FFD780FF>Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source</color> does not consume Kresnik Energy.
passive4.name: Energy Catalysis
